title: NextProb plugin ownership
description: Reviewed ownership mapping in owners.json. It defines maintainers, official namespaces, publishers, and plugin namespaces. Cross-file rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the registry validator: official namespaces must resolve to official publishers, official publishers must own at least one official namespace, namespace values must reference defined publishers, and non-official publishers must not own official namespaces.

maintainers.description: Non-empty list of lowercase GitHub logins allowed to review ownership and manage maintainers.

officialNamespaces.description: Namespaces reserved for official plugins. Every entry must be a key in namespaces whose publisher has official set to true.

publishers.description: Publisher definitions keyed by publisher id.

namespaces.description: Namespace-to-publisher mapping. Keys are matched against plugin ids at dot boundaries; the longest match wins. Values must be keys in publishers.

plugins.description: Optional exact plugin-id ownership overrides. Values must be keys in publishers.

official.description: Whether this publisher is official. Official status is derived from this reviewed file, never from author-supplied metadata.

github.description: Lowercase GitHub logins allowed to submit changes for this publisher's plugins.
